successCriteria.description: Create src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts exporting the LeaveBalance interface with exactly these fields: id (number), employeeId (number), policyId (number), totalEntitlement (number), usedDays (number), pendingDays (number), availableDays (number), fiscalYear (number), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)
Create src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts exporting the LeaveBalanceQueryParams DTO interface for filtering balance queries

Create src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts exporting the ILeaveBalanceRepository interface with these method signatures: findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeAndPolicy, findByEmployeeAndFiscalYear, create, update, deductDays, restoreDays

Create src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts exporting the LeaveBalanceRepository class implementing ILeaveBalanceRepository, using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts for all database operations
Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/balance/ covering the LeaveBalance model structure and LeaveBalanceRepository methods (mocking the pg Pool)
All database access in LeaveBalanceRepository goes through the pg Pool — no inline SQL or ORM calls outside the repository class

constraints: Must import and read src/shared/types/leave.types.ts (Phase 1) before generating any code — this is a declared dependency
Must import and read src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts (Phase 2) before generating any code — this is a declared dependency
All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — use the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks — use unknown with type guards instead of any (HARNESS.json constraint no-any)
No circular dependencies — balance module must not import from modules that depend on it
Jest unit tests must be placed in tests/unit/modules/balance/
outOfScope: Balance service (ILeaveBalanceService / LeaveBalanceService) — deferred to Phase 6
Balance routes (Fastify route handlers) — deferred to Phase 9
Module barrel export (balance/index.ts) — deferred to Phase 9
Integration tests — deferred to Phase 9; this phase delivers unit tests only
Audit record writing (GP-002) — handled at the service layer, not in the repository/model layer of this phase
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — handled at the route/middleware layer, not in this phase
Input validation (GP-003) — handled at the API boundary layer, not in this phase

ambiguities.description: The LeaveBalanceQueryParams DTO fields are not specified in the intent. The code-agent must infer appropriate optional filter fields (e.g., employeeId?, policyId?, fiscalYear?) based on the repository query method names and the pattern established by LeavePolicyQueryParams in Phase 2.
options: Include employeeId?, policyId?, fiscalYear? as optional filter fields (mirroring the repository query methods)
Include only fiscalYear? as the primary filter dimension
Include a broader set: employeeId?, policyId?, fiscalYear?, minAvailableDays?, maxAvailableDays?

ambiguities.description: The method signatures for deductDays and restoreDays are not specified beyond their names. The code-agent must infer parameter types (e.g., deductDays(id: number, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance> vs deductDays(employeeId: number, policyId: number, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>). The choice affects how the service layer in Phase 6 will call these methods.
options: deductDays(id: number, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance> — operate on a specific balance record by its primary key
deductDays(employeeId: number, policyId: number, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance> — operate by employee+policy composite lookup
deductDays(id: number, days: number): Promise<void> — fire-and-forget with no return value
